note: RFC 1661 Section 3.6: "While LCP is in the Opened state, any protocol packet which is unsupported by the implementation MUST be returned in a Protocol-Reject (described later)." Rejudged statically at HEAD; the narrowed claim drops supportsProtocol, which the body never exercised. TestRFC1661UnsupportedProtocolRejectedInOpened sends MPLSCP in Opened and asserts exactly one frame, ProtoLCP, code 8, Rejected-Protocol, the Information field returned verbatim, and state Opened; the mutant at the handleFrame fall-through goes red. TestRFC1661UnsupportedProtocolNotRejectedBeforeOpened asserts zero frames in ReqSent, AckSent and Stopped; removing the Opened gate goes red by reading, though its recorded break is a producer panic that shows reachability only. One unsupported value is sufficient because handleFrame's fall-through handles every unnamed protocol. Disabled-NCP rejection added by 926f01f732 is proved by ncp_disabled_test.go, which this row does not cite.
